KAIXUAN WANG / 王凯萱
Contemporary visual artist based in Shenzhen, China, working across watercolor, oil painting, printmaking and mixed media.

Primary media:
Watercolor, oil painting, printmaking, mixed media.

Core themes:
Architecture, memory, materiality, lived environments, human presence, relation, softness.

Canonical site:
https://kaixuanwang.art/
